title: 06-doorway
prompt:
Design a radical, inventive, high-fidelity desktop WEBSITE concept for a Russian online psychology conference. This is a functioning-looking website with legible navigation, headline, date and registration CTA, NOT a poster, not a moodboard, not a browser in a frame. Show edge-to-edge website, first screen plus a glimpse of the next scene below, wide 4:3 canvas. An experimental cultural-event digital studio made this: surprise, controlled chaos, oversized photographic cutouts, daring scale and spatial storytelling. No familiar SaaS layout, no neat equal cards, no left-copy/right-portrait template, no carousel or fan of photo cards, no large rounded-corner section containers, no graph paper, no grid background, no notebooks or school supplies, no generic blobs or sparkles, no gradient typography. Russian typography: modern Cyrillic sans serif with personality, medium weight, sentence case, NOT uppercase except АСП. Crisp full headline EXACTLY: «Как превратить знания из вуза в первую практику». Keep the ENTIRE phrase readable, no obscured letters, no cropped words, no swapped words. Exact small content: «Студенческая конференция 2.0», «21 ноября 2026 · онлайн», «Участие бесплатно». Exact CTA: «Зарегистрироваться бесплатно». Header logo АСП; links «Программа», «Спикеры», «Участие». Small gift line «Карта психологических подходов — после регистрации». Palette: off-white, almost-black violet #292338, rich purple #7954D4, pale lilac. Design is playful and editorial, not corporate or school-themed. Don't invent endorsements, speaker names or statistics. Composition itself communicates moving from theory to working with clients. All images illustrative, professionally art-directed, physically convincing.
Concept «Войти в профессию». A surreal ARCHITECTURAL website where a HUGE photorealistic open doorway is the central spatial engine. The page background is divided asymmetrically by an angled vertical threshold: pale warm white foreground at left across about two-thirds, deep rich purple behind the doorway at right. One oversized freestanding open door frame starts near x60% and runs from near top to bottom of hero; warm light and long crisp purple shadows spill diagonally across the clean white page. Through the open doorway glimpse a real intimate therapy room with TWO chairs and a plant, not a stock office photo pasted in a card. A cropped adult person's lower legs in ordinary dark trousers are stepping across the threshold near bottom, subtle human scale; no giant smiling portrait. The very large full Russian heading occupies the white space in an asymmetric staircase of lines extending toward the door, close but never behind it: «Как превратить» / «знания из вуза» / «в первую практику». The final words visually approach the threshold, all exact text remains fully legible. Small prose integrated in white negative space reads «От знания о профессии — к своему месту в ней». The clean primary registration button is suspended visually at the threshold in the lower center, a flat dark-violet rectangle with readable white CTA, not text drawn in perspective on the door. A clear date and free-online note stay beside it. Top minimal navigation crosses both grounds with contrast-correct type. Lower 25% is the next SCENE, white with a giant cropped word «Начать» dark violet on the left, and three narrow door-like photographic vertical openings across the right labeled «Клиника», «Частная практика», «Новая профессия». They are part of an architectural editorial landscape, not three generic feature cards. Off-center, cinematic spatial depth, monumental scale, unexpected framing, restrained no gradients. This must feel like a novel website you can enter, with ordinary legible interface elements embedded in the space.
purpose: Concept exploration. Unapproved. Generated secondary text needs editorial correction; use official Academy name and supplied programme tracks.
